proof.title: What makes this PDF useful proof
proof.intro: This trail documents a simple electronic agreement without claiming the signature is a universal replacement for a handwritten one.
proof.consentBody: Every signer ticks a dedicated box first. That consent is timestamped and tied to the email address they provided.
proof.timestampsBody: Creation, invitation, opening, consent, and signature events use an unambiguous UTC format.
proof.fingerprintBody: The SHA-256 covers the canonical content frozen at completion: the agreement, its signers, and their signatures.
proof.eventLogBody: The timeline connects each action to the email address provided by that participant.
proof.pending: The final fingerprint will be frozen once everyone has signed.

contractView.disclaimer: Playful agreement — not a universal legal guarantee. It records an understanding between people, without pretending to be a courtroom wizard.

iou.title: IOU
iou.description: Record money owed and the date it comes home.

body.fun: {{debtor}} confirms that {{creditor}} saved the day by fronting {{amount}}. Pinky promise: the full amount will be paid back by {{dueDate}}. Both people keep a copy, in case anyone's memory suddenly gets creative.
body.serious: {{debtor}} acknowledges owing {{creditor}} the sum of {{amount}}. The amount will be repaid in full no later than {{dueDate}}. Both parties accept these terms and will each retain a copy of this agreement.

item-loan.title: Borrowed item
item-loan.description: Lend something without losing track of who returns it, or when.

body.fun: {{lender}} is entrusting the precious {{item}} to {{borrower}}. The mission: treat it like the last one on Earth and return it complete, unharmed, and no later than {{returnDate}}.
body.serious: {{lender}} lends {{borrower}} the following item: {{item}}. {{borrower}} agrees to take reasonable care of it and return it complete and in good condition by {{returnDate}}.

shared-expenses.title: Shared expenses
shared-expenses.description: Settle who pays what before the group chat gets weird.

body.fun: {{partyOne}} and {{partyTwo}} will split “{{expense}}”, totalling {{amount}}, equally. Everything will be settled by {{settlementDate}}. Domestic peace restored; spreadsheet optional.
body.serious: {{partyOne}} and {{partyTwo}} agree to split the following expense equally: {{expense}}, for a total of {{amount}}. Any balance between the parties will be settled no later than {{settlementDate}}.

bet.title: Bet or dare
bet.description: Carve a glorious challenge and its stakes into digital stone.

challenge.label: The challenge
challenge.placeholder: run 10 km in under an hour

body.fun: {{challenger}} officially dares {{opponent}} to {{challenge}} before {{deadline}}. If they pull it off, {{challenger}} owes {{stake}}. If not, {{opponent}} does. Sore-loser energy forbidden; dramatic flair encouraged.
body.serious: {{challenger}} and {{opponent}} agree to the following challenge: {{challenge}}, to be completed before {{deadline}}. If successful, {{challenger}} will provide {{stake}}; otherwise {{opponent}} will provide it. Both parties will determine together whether the challenge was completed.

roommates.title: Roommate agreement
roommates.description: Set one clear rule for shared-home life and costs.

body.fun: From {{startDate}}, {{roommateOne}} and {{roommateTwo}}, roommates at {{address}}, will split {{sharedExpense}} like this: {{splitRule}}. Everyone pays on time and speaks up if there's a problem — an empty fridge is enough household drama already.
body.serious: From {{startDate}}, {{roommateOne}} and {{roommateTwo}}, residents of {{address}}, agree to share the following costs: {{sharedExpense}}. The split will be: {{splitRule}}. Each party will promptly inform the other of any payment difficulty.

small-service.title: Small service
small-service.description: Pin down a small job, its price, and delivery date.

body.fun: {{provider}} will do the following for {{client}}: {{service}}. Delivery is due by {{deliveryDate}} for {{amount}}. Clear feedback, on-time payment, and a celebratory high-five included.
body.serious: {{provider}} agrees to provide {{client}} with the following service: {{service}}. Delivery will take place no later than {{deliveryDate}}. In return, {{client}} will pay {{amount}} under the terms agreed by both parties.

simple-nda.title: Simple NDA
simple-nda.description: Keep one specific piece of shared information under wraps.

body.fun: {{partyOne}} and {{partyTwo}} will keep this under lock and key: {{confidentialInfo}}. It may only be used to {{allowedPurpose}} and won't be shared with anyone else without prior agreement until {{endDate}}. Lips zipped, deal signed.
body.serious: {{partyOne}} and {{partyTwo}} agree to keep the following information confidential: {{confidentialInfo}}. It may only be used to {{allowedPurpose}} and may not be shared with a third party without prior written agreement until {{endDate}}.
